# The shared simple-operation result names its fallback state instead of leaving a bare Boolean

Accepted SimpleOperationSuccessArgs has separate new_ids and use_legacy_fallback fields, with UseLegacyFallback::Yes/No naming the latter. Copy/move code separately names RequiresResync and converts it explicitly into that payload. The enum comment ties this choice to making this shared result legible while leaving concrete fallback actions operation-specific. This is a local accepted naming pattern, not a rule to replace every Boolean with an enum or a claim that the backed-out tuple proposal remained unchanged. No operation or compile test ran.

Scope: Scoped Rust result naming and typed payload.
